verdict.rationale: Docs mention Perplexity's Computer feature can 'connect to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth,' implying a connector catalog exists, but there is no evidence of an actual browsable directory UI, categories, or user-facing app marketplace, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this experience. Missing for 10: dedicated connector/app directory UI evidence, list of example connectors, independent user reports of browsing/adding connectors.
